<!-- Modified by YurilLAB for BinaryRat. This report will be public. -->

**What happened?**

Describe what you did, what you expected and what you observed. Include the tool, plugin or command involved.

**How can we reproduce it?**

Give the shortest steps you can reproduce with a disposable project or public fixture. Share only the relevant, redacted error text. Keep proprietary binaries, saved investigations and credentials private.

**Which build did you use?**

- BinaryRat commit or artifact name
- OS and CPU architecture
- For Ghidra integrations, Ghidra and Java versions, and whether you used the stock distribution plus the extension or the source-built fork
- For Python commands, Python version
